package.name: ilc_go1_hw
package.description: The Go1 hardware layer for DistILC in ROS 1 (on the robot's own computer): unitree_legged_sdk low-level interface (joints, foot forces, IMU, leg odometry, zero-velocity updates, joint commands with the simulation's safety layer), motion-capture trunk pose, and a robot_localization EKF fusing them.
